title: Diagnostic text sanitizer misses common credential, URL and room-code formats despite the UI's redaction promise
test: tests/diagnosticBundle.test.js · 'sanitizeDiagnosticText redacts <format>' (one test per row of the MUST_REDACT table, 56 rows covering formats a to e), 'sanitizeDiagnosticText leaves benign text alone: <text>' (28 negative rows), 'sanitizeDiagnosticText covers every room-code character the server generates', 'sanitizeDiagnosticText stays fast on long runs of separators', 'diagnostic bundle sanitizes the new formats in readiness and top-level errors'
proof: On the unchanged code 55 of the 90 tests in tests/diagnosticBundle.test.js failed (53 rows of the MUST_REDACT table, the room-code alphabet test and the bundle test); the 28 benign-text tests, the truncation test and the two original tests passed before and after. Examples of the failing output: (a) '"dXNlcjpwYXNz" survived in: Authorization=[redacted] dXNlcjpwYXNz' and 'Authorization=[redacted] username="alice", realm="nextra", nonce="9f8e7d6c", response="c0ffee11"'; (b) '"abc123" survived in: {"token":"abc123"}' and '"correct" survived in: {"password": "correct horse battery"}'; (c) '"AB12CD" survived in: Room AB12CD not found', '... POST /whip/AB12CD failed', '... navigated to #watch/AB12CD'; (d) '"127.0.0.1" survived in: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3001', '"live.example.com" survived in: push to rtmp://live.example.com/app/streamkey123 failed', '"localhost" survived in: listening on localhost:3001'; (e) '"ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789" survived in: key ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789 rejected' and '"q83Hs+2KdLx/9TzVn4bYw0RcPjEaFuMgOi1tAb" survived in: signature q83Hs+2KdLx/9TzVn4bYw0RcPjEaFuMgOi1tAb bad'. After the fix in src/lib/diagnosticBundle.mjs all 90 pass, and a second sanitizing pass changes nothing for every positive row. Existing outputs are unchanged ('Authorization=[redacted]', 'password=[redacted]', 'token=[redacted]', 'Failed URL [redacted-url]').
